measured_by: measurement-prep agent, read-only gh api calls, no writes against GitHub

treatment.manipulation_check: name token coverage on 'mcp invoice generator' goes 0.667 -> 1.000; description and topics unchanged (description already carries the phrase 'invoice generator', so the description axis is saturated and only the name axis moves)

metric_definition.name_token_coverage: lowercase the repo name (part after /), split on non-alphanumerics; a query token matches when it equals a name token, equals a name token minus a trailing s, or is a prefix of one; coverage = matched query tokens / all query tokens
metric_definition.exact_phrase: true when the lowercase name with non-alphanumerics collapsed to single hyphens equals the query with spaces collapsed to single hyphens
metric_definition.note: docs/GH_SEARCH_R2.md reported estate coverage 0.50 on this query under its own (unstated) formula; this file's formula is stated above so every later read is comparable to this one
